LESSON: CARE CARE AND SAFETY

Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: ENVIRONMENTAL
Topic 4.1: Care CARE AND SAFETY

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Care CARE AND SAFETY. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain what Care CARE AND SAFETY means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Care CARE AND SAFETY from Kenya
3. practise Care CARE AND SAFETY in clear steps
4. apply Care CARE AND SAFETY in one real-life situation this week

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: CARE CARE AND SAFETY
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES · Grade: PP1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Care CARE AND SAFETY helps you succeed in ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: CARE CARE AND SAFETY
Study Care CARE AND SAFETY like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Care CARE AND SAFETY means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Care CARE AND SAFETY means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Care CARE AND SAFETY means in simple pupil language.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Care CARE AND SAFETY” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Care CARE AND SAFETY means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Care CARE AND SAFETY from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Care CARE AND SAFETY from Kenya. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Care CARE AND SAFETY from Kenya.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Say why Care CARE AND SAFETY matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Care CARE AND SAFETY from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Care CARE AND SAFETY in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Care CARE AND SAFETY in clear steps. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Care CARE AND SAFETY in clear steps.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Apply: Describe one safe action you can take related to Care CARE AND SAFETY this week.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Care CARE AND SAFETY in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Care CARE AND SAFETY in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Care CARE AND SAFETY in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Care CARE AND SAFETY in one real-life situation this week.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Care CARE AND SAFETY” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Care CARE AND SAFETY in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Care CARE AND SAFETY is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Care CARE AND SAFETY” around your school. (skill: explain what Care CARE AND SAFETY means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Say why Care CARE AND SAFETY matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Care CARE AND SAFETY from Kenya)

Example 3: Describe one safe action you can take related to Care CARE AND SAFETY this week. (skill: practise Care CARE AND SAFETY in clear steps)

Example 4: Name what you can see/touch about “Care CARE AND SAFETY” around your school. (skill: apply Care CARE AND SAFETY in one real-life situation this week)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Care CARE AND SAFETY to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Care CARE AND SAFETY means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Care CARE AND SAFETY from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Care CARE AND SAFETY in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Care CARE AND SAFETY from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Care CARE AND SAFETY: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP1 learner study Care CARE AND SAFETY?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Care CARE AND SAFETY means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Care CARE AND SAFETY means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Care CARE AND SAFETY from Kenya.
